String header values are limited to 2^15-1 (32767) bytes. This string is
32768 single-byte ASCII characters, one byte over the limit, so
implementations MUST fail to serialize the event rather than emitting a
truncated or corrupt frame.

String header values are limited to 2^15-1 (32767) bytes, measured as
UTF-8 bytes, not characters. This string is 8192 four-byte emoji: 8192
characters and 16384 UTF-16 code units, but 32768 UTF-8 bytes, one byte
over the limit. An implementation that measures the limit in characters or
UTF-16 units would serialize this header, so implementations MUST instead
fail to serialize the event rather than emitting a truncated or corrupt
frame.
